This site collects analysis notes and benchmarks built around Polars.

The current write-up compares a Polars `.group_by_dynamic()` workflow against an equivalent DuckDB window query for rolling 60-month beta estimation.

The main write-up is here:

The project is set up as a Quarto website, so you can publish it with:

